requirement: PGDM course duration

notes: Verify current applicability against the relevant AICTE rules.

requirement: PGCM course duration
verification_method: Compare approved programme details with official records
notes: As stated in the handbook.

requirement: PGDM duration for eligible working professionals
applies_to: Working professionals with at least 3 years of relevant managerial/supervisory experience
verification_method: Verify programme category and documented relevant experience
notes: The handbook states the experience condition alongside this duration.

applies_to: PGDM/PGCM admissions, subject to the stated conditions
verification_method: Compare admission records with the applicable AICTE calendar
notes: The source makes the start date subject to grant of EoA for the current academic year. Verify current-year dates.

value: CAT, XAT, CMAT, ATMA, MAT, GMAT or applicable government examinations including CUET
verification_method: Compare published admission criteria with candidate admission records
notes: Preserve the handbook's exception and confirm the current applicable rules.

requirement: Entrance-test score weight
verification_method: Check the published selection formula and admission scoring records

requirement: Academic performance weight
verification_method: Check the published selection formula and academic scoring records
notes: Source refers to Class X, Class XII, undergraduate and postgraduate academic performance.

requirement: Group discussion/interview weight
verification_method: Check the published selection formula and interview records
notes: Use the institution's applicable published selection scheme.

requirement: Sports, extracurricular, academic-diversity and gender-diversity weight
verification_method: Check the published selection formula and supporting records
notes: The combined category is stated as a range in the source.

requirement: Publish entrance-test details and selection-component weights before admissions
verification_method: Inspect dated website and brochure copies
notes: The source also mentions informing applicants through specific communications.

requirement: Display eligibility criteria, selection procedure and merit list
verification_method: Inspect website, portal attachment and merit-list records
notes: The source states selection must be on merit.

requirement: Upload PGDM/PGCM enrolment data within the stated deadline
unit: month after the prescribed admission deadline

notes: The source describes consequences for failure to upload; confirm current rules.

requirement: Include the AICTE-allotted enrolment number on diploma certificates and mark sheets
applies_to: PGDM/PGCM students covered by the clause
verification_method: Compare certificate and mark-sheet records with official enrolment data
notes: Use the prescribed format referenced by the handbook.

requirement: Curriculum conformity with AICTE Model Curriculum
verification_method: Compare curriculum documents with the applicable AICTE Model Curriculum
notes: The source permits institutions to devise curricula subject to the stated conditions.

requirement: Constitute the Board of Governors/Board of Management and upload meeting minutes periodically
verification_method: Inspect constitution records and published meeting minutes
notes: Verify the applicable Annexure-17 requirements separately.

requirement: Refund fee for withdrawal before the specified last date, subject to the stated deduction
verification_method: Compare withdrawal date, refund calculation and payment records

requirement: Publish fees before admissions begin
verification_method: Inspect dated fee schedule and admission brochure
notes: The source also mentions informing applicants through specific communications.

requirement: Upload transcripts and certificates of passed-out students and provide ABC registration details
applies_to: PGDM/PGCM institutions covered by the clause
verification_method: Inspect ABC and AICTE portal records
notes: Confirm current portal requirements and applicability.

requirement: Appoint an Ombudsperson as prescribed by the cited regulations
verification_method: Inspect appointment order and applicable grievance regulations
notes: The source cites the 2019 student grievance regulations.

requirement: Academic session dates
verification_method: Compare academic calendar with the applicable official schedule
notes: The source says the session shall normally run from 1 July to 30 June of the following year.
